name: Employee, CHF 150,000, Zurich, with a full 3a contribution and a CHF 20,000 BVG buy-in
workings: Coordinated salary min(150,000.00, 90,720) − 26,460 = 64,260.00; age credit at 40 10% = 6,426.00; employee half 3,213.00.
Net salary 137,206.80; professional expenses federal 4,000.00, ZH 4,000.00.
Federal taxable 137,206.80 − 33,058.00 of deductions = 104,148.80; federal tax 2,958.2608.
Simple tax 6,444.3920; cantonal 95% = 6,122.1724; communal (Zurich, 119%) = 7,668.8265; personal tax 24.
The buy-in is credited to the BVG with the age credits; the 3a contribution goes into the 3a account (the planner deposits it, so it's no accrual).
The state keeps the buy-in for 3 years: a 2nd-pillar lump sum in 2026–2029 reverses its deduction.
